name: Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Rainwater harvesting structure(nos)
benefit:
1. 33.33 % of cost of construction subject to a maximum of ₹18,000 per structure for General and 75% subject to maximum of ₹ 40,000 /- per structure for SC/ST
1. The above assistance will be for a structure of 200 cu. Mt. capacity lined with silpauline sheet. For lesser capacity the assistance will be limited proportionate to the water holding capacity.
1. Large cardamom growers having land holdin
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a large cardamom grower located in Sikkim, Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal, or other North Eastern States. 1. The applicant should undertake construction activities in a manner that does not block the natural flow of water, including streams, and is not objectionable to the local community or concerned authorities. 1. The applicant should ensure that the proposed rainwater harvesting or irrigation structure complies with all local regulations and environmental norms. 1. The applicant should allow inspection by designated officials, who will conduct the final inspection and recommend only eligible cases for assistance. 1. The applicant should ensure that the Inspecting Officer can verify that no violations of the prescribed conditions have occurred before recommending the case for sanction.
